rootCauses: The governed assignment producer opened a dedicated NOINHERIT runtime login but never entered union_eyes_runtime inside its authority transaction, so actual protected operations failed42501.

The auth-enabled disposable native fixture provisioned only ordinary auth credentials; the Next child incorrectly reused that ordinary gateway URL for AUTH_SYSTEM_DATABASE_URL, which the production auth executor correctly rejects.
repairs: A small owned-fixture adapter enters SET LOCAL ROLE union_eyes_runtime as the first operation callback in the existing runAuthorityTransaction. The kernel/context/session authority and role inheritance are unchanged.
The existing fixture provisions a distinct NOINHERIT LOGIN ue_v2_mutation_auth_system with membership only in nzila_auth_system_gateway and exposes authSystemUrl.

Next child environment requires the dedicated auth-system principal, confines every credential URL to the owned loopback database/port, rejects principal reuse including percent-encoded aliases, and assigns AUTH_SYSTEM_DATABASE_URL to its dedicated URL.
The actual output sanitizer enumerates all four database credential URLs and redacts plain and URL-encoded password forms; the persisted-secret counter remains enforced.

red.meaning: Actual PGlite session_user-restricted runtime operations failed42501; auth-system login was absent; Next child used ordinary auth credentials and failed to reject missing/reused/unowned auth-system URLs. The extraction adapters preserved the original SQL behavior before applying the repair.

pgliteAssertions: Four distinct LOGIN principals are NOINHERIT/NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS/NOCREATEDB/NOCREATEROLE; no cross-gateway memberships, and runtime privileges are not inherited.
SET SESSION AUTHORIZATION verifies the login session_user, not merely SET ROLE from a superuser. Direct protected reads fail before and after the runtime helper.
The helper callback runs as union_eyes_runtime with the existing organization context; foreign-tenant updates affect zero rows; thrown work rolls back and the role restores to its login.
Ordinary auth can enter its identity executor but cannot enter the system executor or read raw auth data.
Dedicated auth-system login can execute a purpose-bound session revocation through source-compiled auth RLS; it cannot enter the ordinary identity executor or read raw bearers.
The business runtime cannot enter either auth gateway or the auth-system executor.
testHarnessCorrection: During initial green verification, PGlite retained the role GUC after RESET SESSION AUTHORIZATION; the test helper now explicitly restores both session authorization and role and asserts both owner values after every simulated login. No denial or workload assertion was removed.
limitations: PGlite is SQL-engine proof. Native socket LOGIN authentication for the new fixture credentials and the complete native schema/Next build/HTTP/browser acceptance have not been executed by this batch.
The actual network-boundary subprocesses and local TLS vault exercise loopback-only synthetic services; they do not prove external/live provider or staging behavior.
The browser test suite here validates acceptance contracts only and does not launch Chromium or claim UI journey completion.
Three source producers changed; regenerate and bind the V2 source plan before further source-bound qualification. Final integrated TSC/repository checks/CI remain root-owned.

publication.meaning: Publication formatting/redaction and published artifact references only; original test outcomes and source digests are preserved
